title: Caller-decoded original documents; SOURCE-only typed consumer V1

lifecycle.description: Whole original documents under aliases group_final, parent_exit_scope, source_grade, common_go, worker_ready, worker_started, env_close, app_close_binding, app_fast_intent OR app_close_returned, parent_started, controller_started, parent_dispatch, outer_parent_wait; optional worker_error/parent_error.

x-scope: Structural schema is documentation, not a second validator. Executable consumer enforces exact decoded Python types, arithmetic, cross-document and clock identities. JSON Schema integer accepts mathematically integral 1.0; consumer additionally checks exact Python int/float and prevents Python bool/int equality.

clock.description: B4 normal/pre/post use complete original clocks. C2 outside adoption clock is a distinct domain: original stored tick/fb/common, outside_scene_update, depth0, control_slot UNKNOWN, is_original_100hz_slot false, no derived sim_time_us. Do not copy adoption fields into event.tick.

x-role-invariants.ENV_ROWS_WITNESS: Explicit original N80 env axis; general codec permits 1..8 unique declared IDs; current producer ABI/public consumer requires metadata IDs0..7. Index binding is caller-declared, not independent readback. Shape axis shrinks only to retained IDs. Standalone synthetic helpers test noncontiguous [2,79].
x-role-invariants.ENV_IDS_FULL: Original integer shape[K], K0..80, source_env_axis null, full retained shape and argument order, VALUES_ARE_ENV_IDS_NOT_ENV_AXIS/preserve_entire_argument true. No first8 cut or env-axis inference.
x-role-invariants.TERMINAL_BOOL_FULL: Original dtype torch.bool, shape[80], axis0, all80 original-order rows, exact bool JSON values; no cast/reduction.
x-role-invariants.QUEUE_GROUP_FULL: Axis0 full80 original-order rows. Twelve queue fields per legs4/wheels2: target matrices float32, valid vectors bool, lag/episode/tick vectors int64. Not a sensor witness.

normal_samples.description: Each slot has original base_ang_vel3, projected_gravity3, leg_pos4, leg_vel4, wheel_vel2. Clean envelope plus complete original B4 payload; five channels totaling16 scalars per witness/slot, no MID remaining19 or clean35.

pack.x-boundaries: Original pre-reset s1[80,73] witness and bool80 flags, original integer reset IDs fullK, original reset before/after state and outcome. No callback, metadata failed, RAISED, late/unjoined, missing END remain distinct. Original raw actor35 only post_return END.

ledger.x-identity: run_id == TASK.group_id + ':E3'; normal_channel_records is actual original key.

worker.x-C2: Every original event retained including auxiliary/unparented writes. Physics event.tick and issue/apply arguments require type(x) is int and >=0, never bool or float. UNPARENTED target_write has separate tick NOT_APPLICABLE domain with raw counter retained, not a manufactured apply(-1). Same-asset term context supplies only parent seq/group/clock; DOF/target/readback join stays UNKNOWN.

incomplete.description: Not a successful FINAL. Original pending owned_partial_control/provenance is retained, never synthesized into a completed pack.

byteClaim.description: Caller-supplied original byte identities are distinct from consumer-computed original.digest(decoded). Source pins and source_ref aliases are claims, not automatic runtime authentication.
